svg.title: Where the layouts are
svg.desc: Every layout in the launcher's installation parameters and in the scenarios, grouped by the place its name points to, west to east, with how sure the location is.

g.text: Layout names from launcher/params/installations and the scenario files; a leading _ abbreviates the first name in the card. Sources are listed in the document.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Layout names start with a street address. Four are confirmed by public sources (Volley's Denver headquarters, its two Manhattan projects and the operating San Francisco garage);

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the others are inferred from the street name and the company's history, and may be wrong.
